snippet.title: Resident Evil Requiem Developer Interview - Future Games Show gamescom 2025
snippet.description:
Resident Evil Requiem producer Masato Kumazawa revealed more details about the forthcoming entry in Capcom's legendary survival horror series during the Future Games Show at gamescom. Experience Grace Ashcroft's story when the game launches on February 27, 2026 for PC, PS5 and Xbox Series X/S.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #residentevil #residentevilrequiem
